description: Create a vehicle service history tracker from scattered maintenance receipts. Open /home/ga/Documents/service_receipts.txt to see raw receipt data. Create a structured spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/car_service_log.xlsx with columns for Date, Odometer, Service Type, Provider, Cost, and Notes. Enter all service records, create formulas for 'Miles Since Last Service' (current odometer minus previous), add a SUM formula for total cost. Format headers as bold, costs as currency ($). Sort records by date (oldest first). Save with Ctrl+S.
